#config-version=FG100F-7.2.6-FW-build1575-231219:opmode=0:vdom=0
#conf_file_ver=41972704244741
#buildno=1575
#global_vdom=1
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.252
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set alias "WAN"
        set role wan
    next
    edit "port2"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set alias "LAN"
        set role lan
    next
    edit "port3"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping
        set type physical
        set alias "DMZ"
        set role dmz
    next
    edit "port4"
        set vdom "root"
        set status down
        set type physical
    next
end
config firewall address
    edit "WEB-SRV-01"
        set subnet 203.0.113.10 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "WEB-SRV-02"
        set subnet 203.0.113.11 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "DB-SRV-01"
        set subnet 192.0.2.50 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "APP-SRV-01"
        set subnet 192.0.2.60 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "INTERNAL-NET"
        set subnet 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "DMZ-NET"
        set subnet 203.0.113.0 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "MGMT-HOST"
        set subnet 192.0.2.100 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "EXTERNAL-DNS"
        set fqdn "dns.example.com"
    next
    edit "BRANCH-NET"
        set subnet 198.51.100.64 255.255.255.192
    next
    edit "BACKUP-SRV"
        set subnet 192.0.2.200 255.255.255.255
    next
end
config firewall addrgrp
    edit "WEB-SERVERS"
        set member WEB-SRV-01 WEB-SRV-02
    next
    edit "ALL-SERVERS"
        set member WEB-SRV-01 WEB-SRV-02 DB-SRV-01 APP-SRV-01
    next
    edit "MGMT-HOSTS"
        set member MGMT-HOST BACKUP-SRV
    next
end
config firewall service custom
    edit "HTTPS-ALT"
        set tcp-portrange 8443
    next
    edit "PGSQL"
        set tcp-portrange 5432
    next
    edit "REDIS"
        set tcp-portrange 6379
    next
    edit "APP-PORTS"
        set tcp-portrange 3000-3010
    next
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "WAN-to-DMZ-HTTPS"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port3"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "WEB-SERVERS"
        set action accept
        set service HTTPS HTTP
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "Allow internet access to web servers"
    next
    edit 2
        set name "WAN-to-DMZ-HTTPS-ALT"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port3"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "WEB-SRV-01"
        set action accept
        set service HTTPS-ALT
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 3
        set name "LAN-to-WAN-Web"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port1"
        set srcaddr "INTERNAL-NET"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set service HTTPS HTTP
        set logtraffic utm
    next
    edit 4
        set name "LAN-to-WAN-DNS"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port1"
        set srcaddr "INTERNAL-NET"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set service DNS
        set logtraffic disable
    next
    edit 5
        set name "LAN-to-WAN-Mail"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port1"
        set srcaddr "INTERNAL-NET"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set service SMTP SMTPS IMAPS
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 6
        set name "DMZ-to-LAN-DB"
        set srcintf "port3"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "WEB-SERVERS"
        set dstaddr "DB-SRV-01"
        set action accept
        set service PGSQL
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 7
        set name "DMZ-to-LAN-App"
        set srcintf "port3"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "WEB-SERVERS"
        set dstaddr "APP-SRV-01"
        set action accept
        set service APP-PORTS
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 8
        set name "MGMT-to-DMZ"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port3"
        set srcaddr "MGMT-HOSTS"
        set dstaddr "WEB-SERVERS"
        set action accept
        set service SSH HTTPS
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 9
        set name "MGMT-to-LAN-Servers"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "MGMT-HOST"
        set dstaddr "ALL-SERVERS"
        set action accept
        set service SSH HTTPS REDIS
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 10
        set name "Branch-to-LAN"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "BRANCH-NET"
        set dstaddr "INTERNAL-NET"
        set action accept
        set service ALL
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 11
        set name "Deny-DMZ-to-LAN"
        set srcintf "port3"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "DMZ-NET"
        set dstaddr "INTERNAL-NET"
        set action deny
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "Default deny DMZ to LAN"
    next
    edit 12
        set name "Disabled-Test-Rule"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port1"
        set srcaddr "INTERNAL-NET"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set service ALL
        set status disable
        set logtraffic disable
        set comments "Disabled test rule"
    next
    edit 13
        set name "LAN-to-DMZ-Backup"
        set srcintf "port2"
        set dstintf "port3"
        set srcaddr "BACKUP-SRV"
        set dstaddr "WEB-SERVERS"
        set action accept
        set service SSH
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 14
        set name "Deny-All-Default"
        set srcintf "any"
        set dstintf "any"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action deny
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "Implicit deny all"
    next
end
